{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define completed orders: status 'completed', revenue not '0.00', and revenue not '999,999.99'
completed_orders = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue'] != '0.00') &
    (df['revenue'] != '999,999.99')
]

# Count the number of completed orders
completed_count = len(completed_orders)

completed_count"}
